|sellprice = 1000 |quality = false }} The '''Raccoon Journal''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be obtained as the reward for the [[Giant Stump#Raccoon's Requests|second request]] from the Raccoon family at the Giant Stump. After fulfilling that request, 999 [[Fiber]] can be traded for one Raccoon Journal at the [[Giant Stump#Raccoon Wife's Shop|Raccoon Wife's Shop]]. It can also be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|20000}} starting in Year 3 (≈9% chance to appear). The first reading grants the player a power that increases the chances to receive [[Mixed Seeds]] or [[Mixed Flower Seeds]] from cutting [[Weeds]] by 4%. Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 100 [[Foraging]] [[Skills|XP]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Penny |like=Elliott |neutral=Abigail,Pierre,Caroline,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Jodi,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Sam,Leo,Wizard |dislike=Alex }} ==Bundles== Raccoon Journal is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Raccoon Journal is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a green dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== Raccoon Journal is not used in any [[quests]]. ==References== See Data\Shops.xnb in the game files.
